id: StrokeVasc matched-boundary Pcom topology illustration v1
claim_boundary: Synthetic, zero-fit engineering illustration. This is not clinical evidence or a new decision gate. D1 and D2 frozen outcomes remain unchanged. No calibration estimates, images, participant records, or protected-set assets are read. No training or prediction inference on patients.

graph.state_order: left Pcom open, right Pcom open
graph.note: Shared per-case prescribed pressure sources and outlet/feed resistances in all arms. Pressure-source adjustments exactly equalize unbridged nodal pressures in balanced regime. A patent bridge has one frozen conductance. There is no readout from CTP, and terminal flow uses synthetic units.

design.sampling: One NumPy PCG64 stream, independent regimes in listed order; independently sampled per-side binary cues with equal prior frequencies at upstream time. Given cues, independently sample the true two Pcom states; generate held-out synthetic measurement from that circuit plus independent Gaussian noise. True state/measurement never enter prediction. The matched experiment deliberately gives the ensemble exact population probabilities; the underconfidence stress deliberately supplies a weaker probability contrast while retaining cue ordering.
design.comparator_note: Three arms share an identical numerical solver and measurement-noise distribution, and the same pressure, distal resistances, and feed resistances for each case. Deterministic arms use a single Normal predictive component; candidate arm uses a normalized mixture. Same information for MAP and mixture. Fixed template is the predeclared assumption of both Pcoms open. MAP is only a synthetic analog of the single-topology interface, not a Strong3D inference or score.

evaluation.primary: Case mean marginal CRPS across three terminal-flow observations, equally weighting cases. Also report MAE of predictive mean and mean 90% marginal interval width and coverage. Paired case bootstrap with 2000 resamples (seed 740621), descriptive percentile 95% intervals against MAP and fixed in each regime. Compare both flow-disagreement across states and predictive scores; do not equate marginal CRPS with multivariate dependence accuracy.
evaluation.checks: Finite positive outlet flows, absolute mass imbalance <1e-10, posterior weights sum to one within 1e-12, balanced physical prediction parity <1e-10 and resulting scores equal, univariate Gaussian CRPS identity at y=mu within 1e-12. Do not tune after seeing scores.
